title: UC Davis - ß Hydroxy Butyrate Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ywafxae
materials: Reconstitute R1 and R2 using the buffers provided.

steps.title: Add Calibrator and Samples
steps.instruction: Add 4 µl of calibrator and sample to each well.

steps.title: First Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 270 µl of R1 to each well and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second Incubation and Reading
steps.instruction: Add 90 µl of R2 to each well, incubate at 37°C for 2 minutes, and perform absorbance readings.

substeps.instruction: Continue reading every 30 seconds for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Calculate Results
steps.instruction: Calculate the slope of the reaction for each well and determine unknown sample concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Calculate unknown samples using the formula: (Sample ΔOD/min ÷ Calibrator ΔOD/min) × Calibrator Concentration.
